name: Canada
overview: Scripture reveals that the nations, including those descended from Japheth such as Gomer and Magog, were divinely apportioned their lands by the Most High, who established boundaries according to His sovereign plan (Genesis 10:2; Deuteronomy 32:8). God's promise to Abram to lead him to a land He would show underscores His providential guidance over nations (Genesis 12:1). Ultimately, all nations, from every corner of the earth, are called to turn to the Lord and worship Him, as He reigns with righteous judgment and dominion extending from sea to sea (Psalms 22:27; Psalms 67:4; Psalms 72:8). This affirms that Canada, like all nations, exists under God's sovereign authority and is invited into His redemptive purpose.
